name: Little Red Fangs
source:
Chased out of your village by flames and arrows, you find yourself on the verge of death when a "dashing" young man rescues you and sweeps you off of your feet (for some reason). Something's not quite right about your "hero." Or maybe you're just reading into him too much. All you know is that he wants you to stay with him at his place. Just for a few days, you suppose.

Just a few.

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/little-red-fangs]itch.io[/url]]
